view: Persepolis Apadana staircase relief close oblique view, shallow carved procession of clothed gift-bearing delegates in weathered pale stone, steps correctly ascending beside relief, a few slender surviving fluted columns distant above terrace. Carved figures not living people, no invented readable cuneiform.

eras.title: The stairway of delegations
eras.caption: Carved figures climb the Apadana stairway carrying gifts for the Achaemenid court. Above them, the surviving columns mark the reception halls of Persepolis, where imperial power was expressed through stone, ceremony and the gathering of peoples.
